events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Born in Manchester, Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis, turns 54.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released 55 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's second solo studio album, 'Imagine', was released on September 9, 1971, in the US and October 8, 1971, in the UK.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. What does this timeless album mean to you?

events.title: Apple unveiled the first iPod 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod on October 23, 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: Tech Anniversary
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago today, Apple unveiled the original iPod. Did you get one of the first models, or did you hold out for a later generation?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the 1962 premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Film Celebration
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate 007 theme tune? Shaken, not stirred, naturally.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Visionary musician and co-founder of The Beatles, John Lennon, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and Monty Python co-founder, John Cleese, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th Birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their iconic 'White Album'. A double LP that broke all the rules – which track is your standout?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Remembering Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Often cited as a pivotal moment in their evolution, what's your favourite track from the album?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: On December 8, 1980, the world mourned the tragic loss of John Lennon, who was fatally shot in New York City.

angles.name: Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who tragically passed away on this day 46 years ago. His legacy of peace and music lives on.
